browser: The user's stable Google Chrome, driven through the official Claude in Chrome extension in its own tab-group window. Held keys were synthetic in-page keydown/keyup events; held touch buttons were pointer events on the real touch buttons; Start, language and Play again were real mouse clicks. Only visible DOM text and canvas pixels were read; no game state was read or injected.
phoneLayouts: The Chrome window could not be resized, so phone layouts were checked in a same-origin 390-wide portrait frame on the page.
servedSourceCheck: Before each final run the SHA-256 of the served game module was computed in the page and matched the reviewed hash.

observed: On a3e98690 (identical except the Spare clamp): a driver that reads only the status-line prompt played timetables 1 to 20 in English back to back and reached 'Nicely played! Every timetable is run - the yard is spotless!' with 0 strikes of its own. The new level 8 layout with two passing loops rendered correctly.

Chinese phone frame, 371 px wide with no horizontal overflow: touch buttons 左 右 上 下 扳道 路线 alone cleared timetable 1 with 0 strikes.
Final build 93677e02: the Chinese loss screen shows Spare 0 (余量 0), no longer -1.

On a7a89556 (identical except the loss banner text): a driver that reads only the status-line prompt played labs 1 to 22 in Chinese back to back and reached '完成得漂亮！所有实验都完成了，弹珠安然到家！' without losing a marble. The plate-charging and wait-for-the-block prompts appeared.
English level select listed all 22 labs with names and tips.
English: blind tilting on lab 3 ran out of lives ('The marble ran out of lives. Try again!'); input on the loss screen changed nothing; Play again opened the level select.
English phone frame, 371 px wide with no horizontal overflow: touch buttons Left, Right, Up, Down and Level alone cleared lab 1.
notes: The loss screen on a7a89556 showed 'Lab cleared!' in the canvas banner behind the overlay. On the final build 54e8579b, served and hash-checked in the page, blind tilting on lab 3 lost again and the banner now reads 'Out of lives'.

console: No console errors during the Rail Switch and Tilt Lab runs.
limitations: Physical phones, touch hardware, other browsers and audio were not tested. The Snowball Siege rebuild is still in development and is not part of this release.
